failures.name: altered, additional and missing emitted artifacts invalidate build evidence
failures.confirmedCause: The test runs four synchronous whole preflight chains to exercise one emitted-artifact contract. The original full Windows run exceeded the unchanged 15000 ms test budget (16379 ms); the recorded failure is timeout, not an artifact-verification assertion. No CPU/I/O profiling established a particular host-load cause.

evidenceRules: Original ci-checks, raw Vitest and full logs are retained unmodified. No successful rerun replaces their failed status.
Failed JavaScript aggregate groups omit cases; per-assertion failures, passes and platform skips above are taken from the raw Vitest JSON, not invented from aggregate case counts.
Windows and Linux share four failed assertions. Windows adds provider-first-pin and tooling timeout; Linux adds the locale assertion. A pass on another platform does not erase a failure.
All 284 planned files were selected: 259 standard on each ordinary platform and 25 root files. Selection is not a claim that every case passed or that all integration boundaries were tested.
The original candidate remains failed even after targeted repairs. A new source-bound clean audit and a new authorized complete matrix are required before publishing.
limits: Linux used isolated ordinary uid 65534 and separate root checkout; production services/configuration were not changed.
Linux Python was host 3.12.3, not the hosted matrix standard 3.12.10; Node 24.22.1, CLI 0.169.0 and Go 1.26.10 were pinned and verified.
The independent first-provider diagnostic is a reproduction, not an additional full-matrix assertion or replacement for the original Windows failure.
This report records observed platform skips individually and does not claim zero coverage gaps or hosted CI completion.
